title: Account locked after failed sign-in attempts
notes: Clean happy-path call. Exercises basic identity extraction, enum mapping, and a fully resolved outcome with no follow-up. All names and references are synthetic.
transcript: Speaker 1: Good morning, SSM Repak support, this is Tom speaking. How can I help you today?
Speaker 2: Hi Tom, my name is Maria Hendriks. I can't log into my account, it keeps saying my account is locked.
Speaker 1: I'm sorry to hear that, Maria. Could you give me your account reference so I can pull it up?
Speaker 1: Thank you. And in case we get disconnected, what's the best email to reach you on?
Speaker 1: Great. I can see the account was locked after several failed sign-in attempts this morning. Let me verify your identity and then I'll unlock it for you.
Speaker 1: I've confirmed your details and reset the failed-attempt counter. I've also sent a password reset link to your email. Could you try logging in now?
Speaker 2: One moment... yes, I'm in now. That's brilliant, thank you.
Speaker 1: Perfect. Your account is unlocked and access is fully restored. Anything else I can help with?
Speaker 2: No, that's everything. Thanks for sorting it so quickly, Tom.
Speaker 1: You're welcome, Maria. Have a lovely day.
